name: Delicate Dental of North Brunswick
what_they_do: Small general dental practice offering preventive, cosmetic and restorative care plus implants, periodontics, root canals and extractions. Site lists Dr. Wenqing (Celina) Zhang, DDS.
customers: Local families and adults in North Brunswick; PPO/insurance patients who find the office through directory listings (CareCredit, Delta Dental, Medicare Advantage directories).

size_signals.signal: One dentist listed (Dr. Wenqing 'Celina' Zhang, DDS); site has an 'About Us' and team photo but no multi-doctor roster
5.0/5 from 76 reviews on a local directory, 154 on another
Appears in the CareCredit provider locator and 2026 Medicare Advantage provider directories

website_review.primary_cta: REQUEST AN APPOINTMENT button (leads to the contact page form); phone icon at top of mobile
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Contact Form 7 form on /contact-us/ only (name, email, subject, message); no appointment request fields and no calendar
website_review.trust_signals: Office exterior and team photos, doctor photo, detailed service tree, 'ADA Compliancer' badge, CareCredit/insurance directory presence
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Copyright reads '© 2025' in November 2026; homepage has almost no readable body copy (276 characters of text on a ~7,300 px page) because the content sits in images; contact page warns the form 'may not load'; no meta description
website_review.search_basics: Title is only 'Precise Care with a Gentle Touch' - it names neither the service nor the town; no meta description; service pages do exist with keyword-style file names (e.g. dentist-north-brunswick-3.png) but headings/alt text are the only signal
top_issues: Homepage is effectively an image: 276 characters of crawlable text, so search engines and AI assistants learn almost nothing
Page title and meta description do not mention dentist or North Brunswick
No appointment request form, no booking, no hours on the homepage
No schema.org JSON-LD at all; copyright year is stale (2025)

agent_readiness.notes: robots.txt allows crawling (only /wp-admin disallowed) and points to a sitemap. But answers are not written as text: the homepage carries ~276 characters, no hours, no price ranges, and there is zero JSON-LD. Booking is a generic contact form on a separate page that the site itself warns may not render; nothing an agent can reliably act on.

operations_signals.signal: Contact page tells visitors to 'call our office' if the form fails - inference: inquiries already get lost, and staff absorb them by phone
Generic 'Your name / email / subject / message' form with no service, date or insurance fields means staff must call back to qualify every request
Single-dentist office with no booking system implies every appointment, reminder and recall is handled manually - inference from the absence of any scheduling tool on the site

top_opportunities.opportunity: Rebuild the homepage as real text (services, hours, insurance, location, FAQ) and add service+town to the title and meta description - the single biggest reason this practice is invisible to search and AI answers
top_opportunities.evidence: Measured 276 characters of body text on the homepage; title is 'Precise Care with a Gentle Touch' with no meta description

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add Dentist/LocalBusiness JSON-LD with address, phone, hours and services, plus an appointment-request form that captures service, preferred time and insurance
top_opportunities.evidence: No ld+json blocks on any page checked; contact form lacks appointment fields and the site warns it may not load

top_opportunities.opportunity: Put a simple online scheduler and automated recall/reminder texts in place so a solo front desk stops being the only booking channel
top_opportunities.evidence: No booking tool anywhere on the site; contact page routes everything to a phone call

scores.reasons: One of the weakest web presences in the batch (image-driven homepage, no schema, no booking) so the gap is large; a single-dentist practice with a 5.0 rating and 76-154 reviews has modest but real budget; fixes are standard content and markup work a one-person shop can deliver fast; verified directly in the browser.
